title: Enable minification for main/preload builds
description: vite.config.ts has minify: false for main and preload. Enabling minify (esbuild) would reduce main.js from 32KB to ~18KB and preload.js from 2.8KB to ~1.5KB.
resolution: Changed minify: false to minify: 'esbuild' in both main and preload vite configs. main.js reduced from 32KB to 20KB.
